books.title: पराशरस्मृतिः
books.desc: A dharmaśāstra in 12 chapters, all 583 ślokas: Sanskrit, Roman transliteration and a plain-English meaning. Opens one śloka at a time.
books.en_note: Machine translation, not proofread: these English meanings were written by an AI model (Claude) directly from the Sanskrit for this reader. They are not a scholarly translation.
about: The Parāśara Smṛti is a dharmaśāstra of twelve chapters, given by the sage Parāśara to his son Vyāsa as the law for the Kali age. The text itself (12.81) says it has 592 ślokas; this edition has 583.

Sanskrit text from Sanskrit Wikisource, used under CC BY-SA 4.0. Verse numbers follow that edition; in chapter 12 the number in brackets is the older numbering. Roman transliteration is generated from the Devanagari.

The English meanings are plain renderings written by Claude directly from the Sanskrit for this reader. They are not a scholarly translation; check a printed edition before relying on a point of law or ritual.
Keys: ← and → turn the page. On a phone, swipe left or right. Type a number such as 3.16 in “Go to” to jump to a śloka.
